title: Astra and a Quick Pass at Articulated 3D Assets
body:
I've been trying Astra on a jam prototype as a quick route from rough ideas to articulated 3D asset concepts. These sheets compare some of the prototype art with the 3D passes I'm exploring for Supper Guard: farm buildings, crops, characters and defensive structures.

The goal is to get a readable little world together quickly, then see which pieces deserve a more careful pass. It's still a playful experiment, but I'm enjoying how the different shapes start to feel like they belong in the same game.

![Supper Guard asset sheet comparing prototype illustrations with 3D versions of a pantry, kitchen stove and research bench.](../media/supper-guard-2026-09-26-astra-articulated-asset-experiment/01-kitchen-and-craft.png)

![Supper Guard asset sheet comparing prototype and 3D versions of a chicken coop, wheat crop and tree.](../media/supper-guard-2026-09-26-astra-articulated-asset-experiment/02-life-on-the-farm.png)

![Supper Guard character sheet comparing prototype illustrations with 3D versions of a hen, fox and worker robot.](../media/supper-guard-2026-09-26-astra-articulated-asset-experiment/03-farm-friends-and-foes.png)

![Supper Guard defense sheet comparing prototype illustrations with 3D versions of an egg launcher, charcoal mortar and kiln.](../media/supper-guard-2026-09-26-astra-articulated-asset-experiment/04-built-to-move.png)
